title: Boro's "Takewhatchuwant" is the perfect introduction for this stellar artist
htmlContent:
Boro is a fast-rising and coming artist in America that cannot be slept on. His voice and style are absolutely amazing, particularly in his recent single "Takewhatchuwant," which keeps his ever-growing fans coming back for more.

Boro's "Takewhatchuwant" is an alt R&B, Hip-Hop, and pop banger about love and its addictive properties. Boro gives you all the lyrical heat and flows packed with fire on this new track. The beat doesn't get to survive a second before. He brings it all down with some of his most impressive emceeing today.
